neighbours.label: the month token ' November' and its spellings in other languages (novembre, november)
fire: The shop will close on November 30 for the holiday.

Nous partons le 12 novembre pour Lyon.

Il revient le 2 novembre de Madrid.

quiet: The shop will close on April 30 for the holiday.

notes: 'October 11' reached 0.33 on the digit in a probe, so a date slot may read a little. Near misses use April to avoid the months next to November.
